implementation: KC API using Power ISA 2.07 for AES core
description: Ubuntu Kernel Crypto API cryptographic module provides cryptographic services to the software components executing as part of the Linux kernel. This test covers the implementations of gcm_base(ctr(p8_aes),ghash-generic), ccm_base(ctr(p8_aes),p8_aes), cbc(p8_aes), ecb(p8_aes), xts(p8_aes), kw(p8_aes), and cmac(p8_aes).
